title: The Wrong Transfer · Part 1
idea: At 2:14 am your bank app says you have $4,800,000; yesterday you had $212. Then a text from an unknown number: 'Don't call the bank. I'm coming for it.' Real facts on cream cards: a bank can take back a wrong transfer; in 2019 a couple in Pennsylvania spent $120,000 deposited by mistake, the bank took it back and they were charged with theft; in 2020 a big bank sent $900 million by accident and fought two years in court. Every tap leaves a trail: the SUSPICION counter climbs as you open the app nine times and search 'can I keep it'. 8:59 am, the bank opens in a minute, and a grey car waits under your window: 'I'm outside.' BANK or WAIT?
hook: Your bank app says you have $4,800,000. Yesterday, you had $212. Then a text, from a number you don't know: “Don't call the bank. I'm coming for it.”
caption:
2:14 AM. Your bank app says $4,800,000. Yesterday it said $212. 💸

Then a text from a number you don't know: "Don't call the bank. I'm coming for it."

Real facts: a bank can take back a transfer sent by mistake. In 2019 a couple in Pennsylvania spent $120,000 that landed in their account by error. The bank took it back, and they were charged with theft. 🧾

8:59 AM. The bank opens in one minute. And there's a grey car under your window. 🚗

Call the BANK, or WAIT for him? Comment one word. The majority writes Part 2. 🦊🏮
first_comment: If money lands in your account by mistake, the safe move in real life is to tell your bank and not spend it. But in the story… BANK or WAIT? 🦊🏮
